snippet.title: Trap Yuri Tempest PV [English Version]
snippet.description:
A romantic storm is brewing at Ayanohara Academy! 
At an elite cross-dressing all-boys school, a scheme to stop heartbroken "he-iresses" leads to the uncovering of an old friend's royal secret, new foes, and new romances in this unique visual novel series!

Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4466710
